Bachelor’s degree in Health Care Administration, Business Management, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and/or experience Strong planning, financial and analytical skills to provide effective leadership for assigned areas
Strong management experience in healthcare administration with emphasis on management of ancillary services to include Laboratory services and regulatory compliance in assigned areas
Minimum 5 years’ experience in an executive leadership role (Director or higher) in a healthcare setting
Minimum 10 years’ experience of progressive management responsibility

The incumbent is responsible for the visionary and strategic leadership in the planning and operation of UC Irvine Health’s hospital operations functions, providing executive oversight for complex, multidisciplinary operations to drive strategic initiatives, operational efficiency, quality outcomes, and continuous improvement.

Responsible for oversight and implementation of operational program planning and development, financial management (operating budgets, revenue and expense management, capital equipment, etc.), strategic planning, process improvement, customer service, patient satisfaction, and policies and procedures development and implementation, and ultimately, the overall operations of the assigned areas and departments. Ensures programs and services are compliant with UC administrative and business policies, as well as federal, state, local, and accreditation agency regulations.
May provide oversight of enterprise-wide operational functions, such as Environmental Services (EVS), Facilities Management, Public Safety, etc. as assigned.
Strong planning, financial and analytical skills to provide effective leadership for assigned areas
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Marketing knowledge and skills to successfully promote assigned programs and services
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Excellent negotiation skills and proven ability to influence others internal and external to the organization
Evidence of sound critical thinking skills and the ability to think creatively and strategically
Demonstrated ability to work across multidisciplinary teams
Ability to successfully represent the UC Irvine Enterprise to the external community
Ability to successfully cross departmental lines of management to organize, guide and direct the development, delivery and marketing of assigned programs and services
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
Ability to develop and implement programs and improve organizational performance
